title: tooling(pin): share the pinned @objectstack build across worktrees, keyed by the pin — a fresh worktree's `pnpm run setup` costs about 3 minutes and 295 MB, a copied build about 6.5 s
body:
Unblocked: objectstack-ai/objectui#12957 closed `completed` when PR #12963 merged as `749ed760`; re-derived with no new blocker (unlock comment below).

**Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer directed:** 「如果需要共享缓存，你就开卡」, in `domain:ui` seat 1's session (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (objectui#12957 dev report, PR #12963)

objectui#12957 puts the pinned build under each checkout's `node_modules/.cache/objectstack`, so every new worktree builds it again.

| case | time | disk |
|---|---|---|
| a fresh worktree, cold `pnpm run setup` at the pin | 175.7 s | +295 MB (cache 201 MB) |
| a second fresh worktree right after | 167.5 s | +295 MB |
| a third worktree with the first one's cache copied in, same command | 6.5 s | +286 MB as a copy; about 85 MB if hardlinked (an estimate, not measured) |

Every os-dev dispatch creates one worktree, so each dispatch pays about 160 s that a shared build would save, roughly 96% of setup. CI is not affected: it already restores the build from a cache keyed by the pin (median cold 111 s, warm restore 2–3 s).

## Done when

1. A build keyed by `.objectstack-sha` and `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` lives once per machine, outside any checkout's `node_modules`, at a documented path that can be overridden.
2. `pnpm run setup` in a worktree whose pin matches reuses it through a copy, a hardlink or a symlink, whichever keeps the frozen install and objectui#12957's lockfile check valid. A mismatched or partial entry is never reused.
3. The second-worktree time and disk are measured and reported against the table above.
4. ⛔ No change to the CI cache, and none to the lockfile's resolution form.
